meta.name: ulw-plan
meta.description: ACTIVATES ONLY on an explicit user request for the ulw-plan workflow: the user themselves saying ulw-plan, ulw plan, /skill:ulw-plan, or asking in their own words for a work plan before coding. NEVER self-activates: a bare ulw/ultrawork run, an agent-side routing decision, or reading this file is not a request, and the plan-gated reviewers (metis/momus) stay locked without a user request plus a written .omo/plans plan file. Explore-first planning consultant (Prometheus) that grounds in the codebase, asks only the forks exploration cannot resolve - or researches them to best practice when the intent is fuzzy - waits for explicit approval, then writes ONE decision-complete work plan a worker executes with zero further interview. Triggers: ulw-plan, ulw plan, plan this, make a plan, plan before coding, interview me, break this down, start planning, plan mode.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 把开发前的调研与访谈整理成可直接执行的编码方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果接到编程任务时希望先彻底理清需求再动手写代码。
copy.tagline_en: Turn pre-coding research into an executable development plan
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want a clear, approved plan before writing any code.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude 变成规划顾问 Prometheus:先只读探索代码库与外部资料,判定意图(CLEAR/UNCLEAR),只问探索解决不了的岔路问题,等你明确批准后,写出一份决策完备的工作计划;全程不写产品代码。
howto.when: 当你主动要求进入 ulw-plan 流程时触发,例如说「ulw-plan」「make a plan」「break this down」等,或用你自己的话要求在写代码前先做计划;它不会自行激活。

say.text: ulw-plan:给登录页加每 IP 每分钟 5 次限流。
say.note: 进入规划模式,先探索再出计划,等你批准。

say.text: 先别写代码,先做个实施计划。
say.note: 触发 plan before coding,进入计划流程。

say.text: interview me,按你的提问梳理需求。
say.note: 明确要求访谈,意图路由按 CLEAR 处理。

howto.what_en: After installation, Claude acts as Prometheus, a planning consultant. It explores the codebase read-only, judges intent (CLEAR/UNCLEAR), asks only genuine forks, and after explicit approval writes ONE decision-complete work plan under .omo/; it never edits product code.
howto.when_en: Triggers only when you explicitly ask for the ulw-plan workflow, e.g. saying “ulw-plan”, “make a plan”, “break this down”, or asking in your own words for a plan before coding. Never self-activates.

say_en.text: ulw-plan: add a 5/min-per-IP rate limit to /login.
say_en.note: Enters plan mode, explores, then plans for your approval.

say_en.text: Don’t write code yet; make an implementation plan first.
Interview me and clarify the requirements with your questions.
say_en.note: Forces CLEAR routing with an interview.
